Good to know

Questions, answered.

What does title insurance protect me against?

Title insurance covers defects in the chain of title found in public records—unpaid taxes, fraudulent or forged documents, incorrectly recorded documents, spurious liens, undisclosed claims from previous owners, and undisclosed easements. Homestead Title does an exhaustive search of the public records, resolves any issues before closing, and you remain cover

Are my closing funds protected if I wire money to Homestead?

Yes. Homestead's underwriter Westcor issues Closing Protection Letters to both buyers and lenders at no charge, guaranteeing funds in the event of agent insolvency or misappropriation. Additionally, Homestead carries Employee Dishonesty and Wire Fraud Insurance that protects you if a third party intercepts a wire and reroutes it—coverage beyond what most tit

How do I verify wiring instructions securely?

Homestead partners with CertifID, which allows you to securely verify your identity and confirm banking details without handing sensitive information back and forth via email. Transfers processed through CertifID are insured up to $1 million.

What is the difference between an Owner's Policy and a Lender's Policy?

In Colorado, the Owner's Policy (typically paid by the seller) insures the homeowner against title defects from previous owners. The Lender's Policy (paid by the buyer/borrower) protects the lender's interest in the property. If you're obtaining a loan, the lender will almost always require a Lender's Policy.

Do you offer closing services for refinances and commercial transactions?

Yes. Homestead provides refinance orders, commercial and investment transaction closings, and national lender services. We work with top banks and mortgage lenders nationwide.

Is there a military discount?

Active and Retired Military Veterans receive a 20% discount on the closing fee. Ask your escrow officer for details.
